messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — NexaSupply just pushed lead times for the H100 PO. Original 4-6w -> now 8-10w. This affects PO# 45891 (30 units) and PO# 45902 (12 units). We need a buffer plan + RMA staging for potential DOAs.
lee_sourcing: Ugh. Which units are affected by the new ETA? can we split shipments?
nexa_supply: NexaSupply (via @nexa_supply): we can split. We have 10 units available from an alternate allocation this week, 20 in the 8-10w pool. Expedited split is possible at a premium.
maria_ops: Which premium? ballpark $/unit?
nexa_supply: +$1,800 per GPU for immediate split-shipment. Standard terms apply for warranty/RMA credits.
felix_finance: +$1.8k x 10 = $18k. What's the impact versus delaying product launches? Need quick comparison.
lee_sourcing: Can we take 10 now and backfill the rest when the bulk arrives? Also what’s the RMA return flow if we accept swap units?
oliver_logistics: AMS staging can hold up to 20 H100s for 14 days with our current SLA. Customs risk: HS hold could add 48-72h if paperwork isn't clean. Storage + handling ~ $30/unit/day after free window.
sasha_warehouse: Confirmed AMS_DC has room for 20 for 10 days at current rates. We can do inbound QA and tag serials on arrival.
maria_ops: Need explicit RMA flow before we sign for expedited split. If any replaced units are DOA we want credit; also we need return labels and manifest.
nexa_supply: RMA flow we propose: 1) Nexa ships expedited 10 units to AMS_DC 2) Redwood QA verifies and tags 3) Any DOA or older-sku returns shipped back on Nexa prepaid AWB within 7 days for credit. We require depot photos + serials.
lee_sourcing: OK can you provide AWB sample and what they need on the manifest?
nexa_supply: Sample: AWB: 987-65432123, carrier: FastAir. Manifest fields: PO, vendor SKU, serial list, qty, RMA reason code.
maria_ops: For customs, use HS 8471.50 and include commercial invoice referencing PO# 45891 / 45902. Also list end-use statement to reduce inspection risk.
oliver_logistics: I'll prebook broker with those docs. Also propose we stage the 10 expedited units in AMS_DC under 'hold-for-eval' tag so they aren't pushed to prod until QA signoff.
logistics-bot: Shipment scheduled: 10 H100 -> AMS_DC. ETA 2025-06-12. AWB 987-65432123. Tracking: https://carrier.example/98765432123
felix_finance: If we take 10 now at +$1.8k, finance approves up to $25k for expedite (quick sign-off) if ops commit to returning DOAs with photos within 72h. Otherwise escalate.
sasha_warehouse: We can do QA within 24h turnaround once arrived. Need power test script and serial scan template.
maria_ops: Power test script (quick):
```
# h100 smoke
power-on; check-fan; run-burn 300s; collect-kvlogs
report: PASS/FAIL + photos
```
lee_sourcing: Action items: 1) Maria to approve expedite (10 units) 2) Oliver to prebook broker + staging 3) Sasha to prepare QA checklist 4) Nexa to send AWB + prepaid RMA labels 5) Felix to lock budget. I'll update PO notes with split-shipment instructions.
maria_ops: I approve the 10-unit expedite at +$1,800 each. Proceed. Please cc me on AWB and manifest.
nexa_supply: Confirmed. We'll send AWB + manifest by EOD. RMA labels attached to shipment; return AWB for 20-unit backfill will be arranged if needed.
oliver_logistics: Noted — staging instructions: tag inventory as "hold-for-eval/nexa-split-175999". If DOA >2 units, halt further deployment and notify sourcing+finance immediately.
felix_finance: Copy. Finance will hold the expedite ledger under project code INF-DEPLOY-3. Reconciliations after returns.
maria_ops: Thanks. If customs delays look likely, we'll convert remaining 20 units to dedicated reserved capacity until arrival. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
